19/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of VR software in driving hardware to generate a sensory VR experience.

19/S1.subgoal: Describe the data flow between the user and VR hardware and where software processing, interaction design, and perceptual design occur.

19/S2.subgoal: Describe the activities needed to create a VR experience and compare ideal and practical developer support in VR software.

19/S3.subgoal: Explain the virtual world generator abstraction and the software support needed to create a virtual world.
